_comment: Birthday announcements. Read fresh every check, so edits apply without a restart.
When the date changes in `timezone`, each person whose birthday it is gets a post in
`channel_id`, a thread on that post for wishes, and `role_id` until the day ends.
message / thread_name: {user} is the mention, {name} is their server display name.
birthdays: one entry per person. `month` is 1-12. A Feb 29 birthday is celebrated on
Feb 28 in non-leap years. `_name` is just a label for whoever edits this file.
Set role_id to null to skip the role.
